_comment: Mythic gear (DD: 'mythic gear that needs materials from every biome'; biome-void 2.23.3, cooks/endgame.md 2.10, cooks/build-endgame.md 2.4). Forged at the Ring on the Crown, no NPC, no menu: offer.perPillar of each biome's signature resource on its pillar, the base item and champion's marks on the centre stone, hold channelSeconds (taking damage breaks it). The result: metal factor tuning weapon.metal.mythic (starsteel x damageScale), sockets fixed at sockets, upgrade cap upgradeCap, two elements at once (your main and subclass paths: each swing carries one, 50/50), and its class's mythic Wildbrand. Mythic armour: armour.marks marks + armour.perPillar of each resource on a +10 biome-set piece; it also counts as a piece of a second set you pick. live is false until the Ring and all twelve resources exist in the build (until then nothing shows). All first drafts.

brand.name: Twelvefold cut
brand.line: Three cuts, the third x2.0 with both your elements' buildup at 60.

brand.name: Fault line
brand.line: A slam that sends a crack 12 m along the ground (low), stance x6.

brand.name: Fell
brand.line: A charged overhead (to 1.0 s): x2.6 on staggered foes.

brand.name: Pillar thrust
brand.line: A 6 m lunge that pins lowland and midland foes 1.5 s.

brand.name: Wake
brand.line: A 300 degree sweep leaving a 3 s line of your main element.

brand.name: Unseen edge
brand.line: A 4 m dash-stab that backstabs from any side once every 20 s.

brand.name: Harvest
brand.line: A spin; each kill inside gives back 15% stamina.

brand.name: Deep strike
brand.line: Ignores half the armour; mining yields x2 for 60 s after.

brand.name: Twelve arrows
brand.line: Twelve arrows in a 20 degree fan (straight, never homing).

weapons.name: Twelvefold band
weapons.line: +5% to both paths' resource gain and both elements' damage.
